Residents Protest Water Scarcity and Lack of Service Roads

Residents in Tiruvannamalai protested the non-supply of drinking water, with panchayat officials stating that existing motor pump sets drawing water from borewells in the riverbed were defunct. Separately, residents in Jogulamba Gadwal protested seeking service road connectivity. The coverage does not specify the dates or duration of these protests.
